name: delphi13-preprocessor
description: Standalone Delphi 13 preprocessor — resolves {$IFDEF}/{$IF}/{$ELSE}/{$ENDIF} chains, {$DEFINE}/{$UNDEF}, {$I X.inc} includes, and numeric directives. Produces preprocessor-resolved text suitable for tree-sitter-delphi13-pure or any other consumer that prefers a flat source.
author: Alexander Liberov
